# Chivora — D365 Data Migration Specialists

> Chivora is a UK consultancy that specialises exclusively in Microsoft Dynamics 365
> data migration. We move critical business data from SAP, Oracle, Sage, Dynamics NAV,
> BPCS, IFS and Access Dimensions into D365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Customer
> Engagement (CE). We treat data migration as a discipline, not a task — with
> reconciliation, cutover planning and audit-ready evidence built into every engagement.

Contact: info@chivora.co.uk | +44 151 453 4230 | https://www.chivora.co.uk/contact
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/chivoraconsulting/
Area served: United Kingdom (remote and on-site)

## Services

- [End-to-End Data Migration](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/end-to-end-data-migration): Full-lifecycle D365 migration — strategy, mapping, transformation, mock loads, cutover and reconciliation.
- [Data Migration Health Check](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/data-migration-health-check): Independent review of an in-flight D365 migration workstream with a prioritised risk report.
- [Migration Rescue](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/migration-rescue): Recovery of failing or stalled D365 migrations.
- [Post-Go-Live Retainer](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/post-go-live-retainer): Ongoing data support after D365 go-live.
- [Data Cleansing & Enrichment](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/data-cleansing-enrichment): Source-data quality remediation before migration.
- [Data Migration Project Management](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/data-migration-project-management): Dedicated leadership of the migration workstream.
- [Integration & Interface Services](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/integration-interface-services): Interfaces between D365 and surrounding systems.
- [Data Governance & MDM](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/data-governance-mdm): Master data management and governance for D365 estates.
- [Reconciliation & Analytics](https://www.chivora.co.uk/services/reconciliation-analytics): Migration reconciliation reporting and audit evidence.
